item.text: [{"task_id":"f5b8619d","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    fill = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    repeats = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    if repeats < 1 or repeats * max(grid.shape) > 30:","        return grid.copy()","    result = grid.copy()","    for column in range(grid.shape[1]):","        if np.any(grid[:, column] != background):","            result[:, column] = np.where(grid[:, column] == background, fill, grid[:, column])","    return np.tile(result, (repeats, repeats))"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,8,2]},"rationale":"Fill background cells with 8 in every column containing a nonbackground cell, preserve the original colored cells, then tile the completed grid twice vertically and horizontally."}]
